micro_markets.name: Bandra East / BKC Annexe (Kala Nagar, Gandhi Nagar)

catalysts.name: Metro Line 3 (Aqua Line) with BKC station, Cuffe Parade - Aarey JVLR, fully operational
Metro Line 2B (Yellow Line) DN Nagar - Mandale: Bandra and Income Tax Office (BKC interchange) stations
Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train, underground BKC terminal station
Bandra Kurla Complex business district (offices, Jio World Centre)

micro_markets.notes: A redevelopment-led luxury pocket between the Western Express Highway and BKC; older MHADA / MIG colonies are being rebuilt as gated towers such as Rustomjee Seasons, Rustomjee Oriana and Kalpataru Magnus. Keystone's 2022 DRHP (citing MahaRERA) says 82% of Bandra East launches in 2017-2021 (1,378 units) were redevelopment. Square Yards (Sep 2026): average asking price about Rs 56,150/sq ft, average rent Rs 198/sq ft, gross rental yield 4.23%; its government-registration average is shown as Rs 37,700 or Rs 32,400 in different places. Mumbai Property Exchange cites a ready reckoner rate of about Rs 26,000/sq ft (2025-26). Line 2B's Mandale-Diamond Garden section opened in Apr 2026, but the Bandra / BKC stations are listed for Dec 2027. The bullet train's first stretch (Surat-Bilimora) is planned for Aug 2027 and the full line for 2029.

micro_markets.name: Khar West

catalysts.name: Metro Line 2B (Yellow Line) along S.V. Road, DN Nagar - Bandra - Mandale
Versova-Bandra Sea Link (with Carter Road and Juhu Koliwada connectors)
Mumbai Coastal Road linked to Bandra-Worli Sea Link (fast access to Worli and South Mumbai)

micro_markets.notes: Upscale residential pocket between Bandra and Santacruz, with low new supply: Keystone's 2022 DRHP (citing MahaRERA) counts only 331 units launched in 2017-2021, 101 of them redevelopment. Square Yards (Sep 2026): average asking price about Rs 62,150/sq ft, government-registration average Rs 44,200/sq ft (Nov 2025-Oct 2026), rent about Rs 217/sq ft, gross yield 4.19%. Line 2B stations from Juhu through Bandra are listed for Dec 2026 to Dec 2027. The Versova-Bandra Sea Link was only about 8% complete in May 2023 and has an Aug 2027 target opening, so further slippage is likely.

micro_markets.name: Andheri West (Oshiwara, Lokhandwala, Four Bungalows)

catalysts.name: Metro Line 2A (Yellow Line) Dahisar - DN Nagar along New Link Road
Metro Line 2B (Yellow Line) extension DN Nagar - Bandra - Mandale
Metro Line 6 (Pink Line) Swami Samarth Nagar - Vikhroli

micro_markets.notes: A large, mixed suburb popular with the film industry. Luxury stock is concentrated in Oshiwara / New Link Road (e.g. Oberoi Springs) and Lokhandwala. Square Yards (Sep 2026): average asking price about Rs 41,400/sq ft, government-registration average Rs 27,900/sq ft (Nov 2025-Oct 2026), rent Rs 130/sq ft (Rs 150 in another table), gross yield 3.77%. Mumbai Property Exchange gives an Andheri West gross yield of about 3.9% and a ready reckoner of Rs 33,200/sq ft carpet. The Metro Line 6 date is from a property portal only, not an official MMRDA source.
